title: Climbing Stairs

statement.hi: Tum ek staircase chadh rahe ho jisme `n` steps hain. Ek baar me tum **1 ya 2** steps chadh sakte ho. Top tak pahunchne ke kitne **alag tareeke** hain? Count return karo.
statement.en: You are climbing a staircase with `n` steps. Each time you can climb **1 or 2** steps. In how many **distinct ways** can you reach the top? Return the count.

hi: Last move ya to 1 step tha ya 2 steps.
ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2) — sirf last do values yaad rakho.
en: The last move was either 1 step or 2 steps.
ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2) — keep only the last two values.

approach.hi: Step `i` pe pahunchne ke tareeke = step `i-1` se + step `i-2` se. Ye Fibonacci hai. Do variables se bottom-up chalao. O(n) time, O(1) space.
approach.en: Ways to reach step `i` = ways from `i-1` + ways from `i-2`. That is Fibonacci. Iterate bottom-up with two variables. O(n) time, O(1) space.
